description_en: Modifies the parameters of a single node and applies them to the specified node
description_zh: 修改单个节点的参数并应用到指定节点
name: ModifyDBNodesParameters

parameters.help_en: The node IDs. You can specify multiple node IDs separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 节点ID。支持传入多个节点ID，多个节点ID间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: db_node_ids

parameters.help_en: The JSON string of parameters and their values. Only node-level parameters can be modified. You can call the DescribeDBClusterParameters operation and select parameters where IsNodeAvailable is set to 1 and IsModifiable is set to true. To modify cluster-level parameters, call the ModifyDBClusterParameters operation
parameters.help_zh: 参数及参数值的 JSON 字符串。仅支持修改节点级参数；可调用 DescribeDBClusterParameters，并选择 IsNodeAvailable=1 且 IsModifiable=true 的参数。集群级参数请通过 ModifyDBClusterParameters 修改
parameters.name: parameters

parameters.help_en: The earliest time to execute the scheduled kernel version upgrade task. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 开始执行定时（即在目标时间段内执行）内核版本升级任务的最早时间。格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ（UTC）
parameters.name: planned_start_time

parameters.help_en: The latest time to start the scheduled task. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 开始执行目标定时任务的最晚时间。格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ（UTC）
parameters.name: planned_end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to execute the parameter modification and restart immediately or at a scheduled time. Valid values:
false: executes the task at a scheduled time. This is the default value.
true: executes the task immediately
parameters.help_zh: 立即执行或定时执行修改参数并重启取值：  false（默认值）：定时执行 true：立即执行
parameters.name: from_time_service
